entities.name: PMID:25084362
observations: 2014 PLoS One postal survey of German cardiac-surgery anaesthesia departments; 51 of 81 returned questionnaires (63%), with 50 analyzed.

Reported colloid use at 88% of centers; HES was first-choice colloid in 64%. Norepinephrine was selected for vasoplegia by 96%; choices for low cardiac output varied (dobutamine 32%, epinephrine 30%).
